mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account (account_id, owner, description, minimum_balance, balance) VALUES (#{accountID}, #{owner}, #{description}, #{minimumBalance}, #{balance})
mapper.update: UPDATE account SET balance = balance + #{amount}, version = version + 1 WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND version = (SELECT version FROM account WHERE account_id = #{accountId})

UPDATE account SET balance = balance - #{amount}, version = version + 1 WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND balance - #{amount} >= minimum_balance AND version = (SELECT version FROM account WHERE account_id = #{accountId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM account WHERE owner IN ('test-user', 'debit-user', 'credit-user')
